stage: Gate 2 — the seven samples through the real template, measured on the rendered HTML, with a like-for-like baseline read from the live site

method.database: a disposable local PostgreSQL database created for this run, migrated 0001-0025, seeded with the legacy drugs/inventory_resolutions/medicine_slug_redirects rows copied from the working database so slug assignment matches what Phase 5 will meet, dropped at the end
method.load: scripts/corpus-20k/load/materialise.ts, --indexable-threshold 11 from data/corpus-20k/gate1b/summary-v3.json; all of Tier 1 and Tier 2 plus Tier 3 batch 1 (which carries both Tier 3 samples); markers under data/corpus-20k/gate2/load-markers; --no-checkpoint, because this is a measurement load into a disposable database and not the Phase 5 load the state file records
method.build: an isolated copy of the worktree with its own .next (the Phase 4 builder's method), next build then next start on port 3111
method.extractor: scripts/corpus-20k/gate2/extract.py — one extractor for our HTML and the live site's: the visible text of <main>, with every <nav> (the contents rail included), the <footer>, the details.cd-contents control that replaces the rail below 1024 px and the definitions link removed as declared markup
method.harness: scripts/corpus-20k/overlap/measure.py unchanged (seed 20260904, 128 permutations, 5-gram shingles), exhaustive on every set; size-matched folds by scripts/corpus-20k/gate2/folds.py reusing gate1b_v3.fold_membership
method.draws: the same seeded 803 and 324 draws Gate 1b used, read from data/corpus-20k/render/v3/pages-indexed-{803,324}.ndjson

load.note: the deployment plan blocks a deploy below 1 page/second; this is 110x that

indexable.note: Gate 1b derived the threshold on the page-text renderer's present-field count; the loader counts only the entries inside the fields record, so 521 pages clear 11 where Gate 1b counted 638. The cause is recorded under issues.

samples.rule: the joint-highest present-field count in Tier 1 (15 of 15), alphabetically first of the two
at the LONGEVITY median of 10 present fields; the median-count page carrying the most question blocks, ties broken alphabetically
the highest present-field count among withdrawn pages that are not suppressed, so the dated arc leads the page
classes S1, S3, S4, S6; the supervision block is ordinal 0
at the Tier 2 median of 3 present fields; the median-count page carrying the most question blocks
the highest present-field count (7) among the loaded Tier 3 development pages, ties broken alphabetically
the lowest present-field count (1) among the loaded Tier 3 stubs, ties broken alphabetically

sizeMatchedFolds.label: gate2: indexable pages scored inside seeded 324-page folds

decomposition.definition: the share of a page's word occurrences whose word appears on more than 90% of the other pages in the same set; it rises as a set gets smaller and more uniform in subject
decomposition.note: the 521 indexable pages are one page type on one subject, so the figure is dominated by English function words, the ISO dates every provenance anchor prints and the vocabulary of clinical evidence. On the like-for-like 604-page comparison the same statistic falls from 0.796 (live) to 0.236 (new).

questions.mostRepeatedExample: 53 of Oxytocin's trials stopped: safety, accrual/recruitment, funding/business, other?

highestTemplateShare.note: R7 binds strings, not templates; reported for information as Gate 1b did

questions.repeatedStringCause: the 65 repeated strings are name collisions between two pages carrying the same display name (data/corpus-20k/identity/slug-collisions-pass2.json), not a template repeating itself

definition.crawl: visible characters of the whole server document / HTML bytes
definition.live: document.body.innerText / document.documentElement.outerHTML in Chromium after hydration

browserChecks.headingOrder: h1 -> h2 (questions) -> h3 (revealed groups) on all seven samples at 1440 px and 320 px; exactly one h1 per page; no level skipped
browserChecks.keyboard: every <details> summary, contents-rail link and provenance anchor took focus with a visible ring on all seven samples at both widths; 0 required targets without a ring

overflowCause.sirolimus: a <dd> in the synonyms list (a long unbroken recorded name)

suppression.note: the two time-to-signal blocks in the whole load sit on two unsuppressed pages (threonine, threonine-2); the 281 audited pages carrying an n-of-1 block are all unsuppressed

domPath.reading: the bar's own markup is unmodified in this worktree (app/page.tsx has no diff; the HomeSearch wrapper, bar div and input JSX have no diff — only the hook and the dropdown list below the bar changed), and every measured box is identical to the hundredth of a pixel at all three widths, so this is a difference in the recorded path notation and in two ancestor indices, not a change to the frozen bar. Reported, not treated as a STOP.

verdict.rule: proceed without asking at indexed positional <= 0.20; diagnose, fix once and re-measure between 0.20 and 0.30; stop above 0.30 or if suppression failed
verdict.qualification: the uniqueness gate clears on the first measurement, so no fix was applied and nothing was re-measured. Three defects found on the way must be fixed before the Phase 5 load; they are listed under issues and none of them is an overlap problem.
